items.title: BullsEye: Directed Firmware Fuzzing
items.summary: The widespread adoption of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has expanded the digital attack surface, making firmware analysis critical for modern software security. A key security concern stems from the frequent reuse of third-party software components, a practice that often introduces known vulnerabilities into firmware images. Whether a given image actually exposes such a flaw is an open question, and public proof-of concept exploits make answering it urgent. Directed Greybox Fuzzing (DGF), a technique that enables targeted exploration of specific binary locations, offers a promising solution for detecting such vulnerabilities. However, DGF has reached firmware only at function granularity, too coarse to aim at the vulnerable block itself. This article presents BULLSEYE, the first DGF framework to schedule closed-source Linux-based firmware fuzzing by basic-block-level distance to user-specified targets. Our methodology combines static and dynamic analysis to enable DGF in the constrained firmware domain, focusing on vulnerabilities in reused third-party components. We introduce novel DGF heuristics that address limitations of traditional approaches. We compare BULLSEYE against four greybox-fuzzing baselines sharing its execution back-end, including reimplementations of AFLGO and WINDRANGER, and against GREENHOUSE, a state-of-the-art firmware re-hosting framework. On 40 vulnerability sites across 32 firmware images, BULLSEYE reproduces every target within budget, against 35 for the strongest of the four baselines, and reduces Time-to-Exposure by a geometric mean of 9.5x to 72.5x over them; against GREENHOUSE, on the 18 targets its pipeline supports, BULLSEYE is faster by a geometric mean of 9.8x.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出BULLSEYE，首个面向闭源Linux固件的定向灰盒模糊测试(DGF)框架，以基本块级距离调度模糊测试，精准定位用户指定目标。背景是IoT设备广泛使用，第三方组件复用导致已知漏洞混入固件，但确定特定镜像是否暴露漏洞十分困难，公开PoC加剧紧迫性。现有DGF技术仅能达到函数粒度，无法精确瞄准漏洞块。BULLSEYE结合静态与动态分析，在固件受限环境下实现DGF，并引入新启发式策略弥补传统方法不足。实验在32个固件镜像的40个漏洞站点上，BULLSEYE成功重现所有目标，而四种基线中最强者仅现35个目标；与基线相比，暴露时间几何平均降低9.5至72.5倍；与最先进的固件重托管框架GREENHOUSE相比，在其支持的18个目标上平均提速9.8倍。结果表明，BULLSEYE能够高效、精准地验证闭源固件中第三方组件的漏洞可达性，为固件安全分析提供了有力工具。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 固件漏洞验证困难，BULLSEYE将DGF精度提升至基本块级，显著加速已知漏洞确认，有助于蓝队评估固件暴露风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响固件安全分析工具链，可应用于IoT固件审计、漏洞验证和补丁评估。

items.why_it_matters: 固件漏洞验证困难，BULLSEYE将DGF精度提升至基本块级，显著加速已知漏洞确认，有助于蓝队评估固件暴露风险。

items.title: MemCatalyst: Amplifying Data Auditing on Vision-Language Models via Data Poisoning
items.summary: Vision-Language models (VLMs) achieve outstanding performance largely due to the amount of training data available on the internet. At the same time, data holders (e.g., artists) urgently need to determine whether their data has been used for model training without authorization, which concerns both intellectual property rights and personal privacy. Data auditing, particularly through membership inference (MI), has attracted attention as a direct tool. This work proposes MemCatalyst, a set of data poisoning tools, aiming to amplify the data auditing performance on VLMs. MemCatalyst employs two strategies: Poisoning Text (PT) and Poisoning Image (PI). MemCatalyst forces VLMs to over-learn specific inconsistencies between image features and textual semantics during training, thereby increasing their susceptibility to membership information auditing. Crucially, the transferability of poisoned samples across different VLM architectures is demonstrated to be effective in the black-box setting. Extensive evaluations using five state-of-the-art data audits on two prominent VLMs demonstrate that MemCatalyst markedly enhances MI AUC scores with a minimal budget of poisoned samples, while maintaining a negligible impact on model performance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）训练数据可能未经授权使用的问题，提出了一种名为 MemCatalyst 的数据投毒工具集，用于增强数据审计（尤其是成员推理攻击）的性能。数据持有者（例如艺术家）迫切希望判断其数据是否被用于模型训练，以保护知识产权和个人隐私。然而，直接在 VLM 上进行成员推理往往不够准确，因为模型在海量数据上训练，单个样本的印记较弱。为此，作者提出 MemCatalyst，通过两种策略来放大训练痕迹：文本投毒（Poisoning Text, PT）和图像投毒（Poisoning Image, PI）。其核心思想是，在训练数据中注入包含特定不一致性的样本，迫使 VLM 在训练时过度学习这些异常关联，从而在模型参数中留下更强的成员印记。具体而言，PT 针对文本内容进行扰动，PI 则对图像特征进行修改，二者共同作用使模型对投毒样本的记忆远超正常样本，进而更容易被成员推理识别。一个重要优势是，投毒样本在不同 VLM 架构之间具有可迁移性，这意味着在某个模型上构建的投毒数据集可以用于审计另一个黑盒模型，极大提高了实用性。实验部分，作者在两种代表性 VLM 上测试了五种最先进的数据审计方法，结果证明 MemCatalyst 能以极小的投毒预算（例如少于 0.5% 的训练数据）显著提升成员推理的 AUC 分数，并且对模型在通用任务上的性能影响可忽略不计。这项研究不仅提供了一种高效的数据审计增强技术，也揭示了数据投毒在隐私审计领域的潜在应用边界，为后续研究提供了重要参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出了一种实用的数据审计增强技术，使数据持有者能够更有效地检验其数据是否被未经授权用于 VLM 训练，对知识产权保护和隐私合规具有重要意义。同时，该技术也展示了数据投毒的另一种用途，安全从业者应关注其可能被恶意利用的风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响涉及 VLM 数据审计、成员推理、隐私保护等领域，可迁移到其他多模态模型或联邦学习场景，用于合规审计与数据泄露检测。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究提出了一种实用的数据审计增强技术，使数据持有者能够更有效地检验其数据是否被未经授权用于 VLM 训练，对知识产权保护和隐私合规具有重要意义。同时，该技术也展示了数据投毒的另一种用途，安全从业者应关注其可能被恶意利用的风险。

items.title: Benchmarking Automated Security Patch Backporting: How Far Are We?
items.summary: Automated security patch backporting is critical for mitigating N-day vulnerabilities. Recent tools report success rates above 80% on their respective datasets. However, these evaluations are often confined to homogeneous environments, such as one repository or specific project versions. Consequently, it remains unclear how well these tools generalize beyond their originally targeted scenarios. We present Porting Benchmark, a curated dataset of 1,234 security patch backporting cases spanning cross-version, cross-branch, and cross-repository scenarios, paired with a common evaluation framework. Using this benchmark, we evaluate five tools spanning program analysis, LLM prompting, and LLM agents under aligned settings. Our results show that aligned evaluation changes the apparent performance landscape: PortGPT and TSBPort remain comparatively strong on the Replication Dataset, while FixMorph and Mystique degrade substantially under the common protocol. Performance degrades sharply on structurally complex patches: the best commit-level success rate falls from 85.2% on Type-I patches to 24.0% on Type-IV. We identify four root-cause categories (missing target API awareness, cross-version semantic mismatch, non-local dependency propagation failure, and patch construction or localization failure) and derive concrete directions for next-generation tool design. On a 45-case dynamically validated subset with verified test cases and constructed POCs, we further observe that reference-based benchmark scores do not fully capture real-world remediation: exact match sharply under-credits harder target adaptations, while executable validation reveals residual integration failures in the target that static reference agreement misses. Executable-feedback refinement provides limited but measurable recovery on the hardest executable cases.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 自动化安全补丁反向移植（backporting）是缓解 N-day 漏洞的关键环节。近期一些工具声称在其各自数据集上实现了超过 80% 的成功率，但这些评估往往局限于同质化环境，例如单一代码仓库或特定项目版本，导致工具在实际跨场景中的泛化能力未知。针对这一空白，本文提出了 Porting Benchmark——一个包含 1,234 个安全补丁反向移植案例的基准数据集，覆盖跨版本、跨分支、跨仓库等多种现实场景，并配套统一的评估框架。作者采用对齐的评测协议，系统评估了五类具有代表性的工具：基于程序分析的工具、基于 LLM 提示的工具以及基于 LLM 智能体的工具。结果表明，统一评测显著改变了原先的性能格局：PortGPT 和 TSBPort 在复制数据集上依然表现相对稳健，而 FixMorph 和 Mystique 在公共协议下性能大幅下降。进一步分析发现，补丁结构复杂度对性能影响显著——在 commit 级成功率上，最简单的 Type-I 补丁为 85.2%，而最复杂的 Type-IV 补丁仅有 24.0%，呈断崖式下跌。作者将失败归纳为四类根因：目标 API 感知缺失、跨版本语义不匹配、非本地依赖传播失败、以及补丁构造或定位失败，并据此对下一代工具设计提出了具体方向。此外，在 45 个具备验证测试用例和构造 PoC 的动态校验子集上，实验显示基于引用（reference）的基准评分无法完全反映真实世界的修复效果：精确匹配指标会严重低估更难的目标适配，而可执行验证能够暴露静态引用比对无法发现的集成失败。引入可执行反馈进行细化，在最具挑战性的案例上虽提升有限，但确实带来了可测量的恢复效果。该工作为安全补丁反向移植工具提供了更可靠、更贴近实际的评估基准，对自动化漏洞修复的研究和工程实践都有重要的参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本研究表明基于单一数据集评估的自动化补丁反向移植工具存在严重的泛化问题，直接关乎 N-day 漏洞修复的可靠性与实际落地。SOC 和漏洞管理团队在选用此类工具时需警惕虚高的基准成绩，本基准和评估框架为真实场景下的工具选型与验收提供了重要参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响依赖自动化补丁移植的软件供应链安全实践、漏洞管理流程，以及 LLM 智能体在安全代码修复领域的应用方向。适用于评估补丁移植工具、改进逆向移植算法、以及研发更鲁棒的自动化修复系统。

items.why_it_matters: 本研究表明基于单一数据集评估的自动化补丁反向移植工具存在严重的泛化问题，直接关乎 N-day 漏洞修复的可靠性与实际落地。SOC 和漏洞管理团队在选用此类工具时需警惕虚高的基准成绩，本基准和评估框架为真实场景下的工具选型与验收提供了重要参考。

items.title: MobileWorldSafety: Benchmarking GUI Agent Safety Against Environmental Injection Attacks in Android Apps
items.summary: LLM-powered GUI agents that autonomously operate smartphones are rapidly transitioning from research prototypes to early real-world deployment. However, because these agents routinely process untrusted environmental content, they are highly vulnerable to environmental injection attacks, which include indirect prompt injections and adversarial instructions. Such attacks can manipulate the behavior of agents without user awareness through diverse channels encountered in everyday mobile use. Despite these risks, existing benchmarks often fail to capture everyday user scenarios, lacking a systematic evaluation of GUI agents under environmental injection attacks on mobile devices. To address this gap, we introduce MobileWorldSafety, a benchmark of 142 risk tasks built on real Android applications. For each task, we define a programmatically verifiable risk indicator over the final system state and evaluate outcomes with a two-stage pipeline: rule-based verification handles unambiguous cases, while an LLM judge adjudicates ambiguous ones. This distinguishes safety failures from capability failures and enables objective and reproducible assessment. Evaluations on six agents, including both general agents and specialized GUI agents, demonstrate that all agents remain highly vulnerable, with attack success rates ranging from 40.4% to 66.9%. These findings indicate that current agents often fail to maintain safety alignment when adversarial content is presented as ordinary mobile context. MobileWorldSafety provides a foundation for quantifying these vulnerabilities and advancing research on robust mobile GUI agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文针对 LLM 驱动的手机 GUI 智能体（例如能自主操作智能手机的智能助手）面临的环境注入攻击风险，提出了一个名为 MobileWorldSafety 的安全基准测试。研究背景是：这类智能体从原型走向实际部署，但它们会频繁处理不可信的屏幕内容（如网页、短信、通知等），因此极易受到间接提示注入或对抗性指令的影响，攻击者可以通过日常手机使用中的多种渠道在用户无感知的情况下操纵智能体行为。现有基准测试往往忽略真实用户场景，缺乏对移动设备上 GUI 智能体在环境注入攻击下的系统评估。为此，作者基于真实 Android 应用构建了包含 142 个风险任务的基准。每个任务定义了一个可通过程序验证的风险指标（基于最终系统状态），并使用两阶段评估管道：规则验证处理明确情况，LLM 裁判处理模糊情况，从而区分安全失败与能力失败，保证评估的客观性和可复现性。作者对六个智能体（包括通用智能体和专用 GUI 智能体）进行了评估，结果显示所有智能体都高度脆弱，攻击成功率在 40.4% 到 66.9% 之间。这表明当对抗性内容以普通移动上下文形式呈现时，现有智能体往往无法保持安全对齐。MobileWorldSafety 为量化这些漏洞和推动鲁棒移动 GUI 智能体研究提供了基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了 LLM GUI 智能体在真实移动场景中的普遍安全缺陷，攻击成功率高，且攻击途径贴近日常使用，对即将到来的智能体部署具有重要警示意义。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了 LLM GUI 智能体在真实移动场景中的普遍安全缺陷，攻击成功率高，且攻击途径贴近日常使用，对即将到来的智能体部署具有重要警示意义。

items.title: An Emulation Anchored Digital Twin Testbed for Cyberattack and Defense Analysis in Hospital IT OT Environments
items.summary: Modern hospitals increasingly rely on integrated Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) infrastructures to support critical healthcare services. However, this convergence expands the cybersecurity attack surface and makes safe validation of defensive mechanisms difficult on live systems. Existing testbeds often focus on isolated IT or OT environments and do not capture realistic cross-domain healthcare interactions. This work presents a hospital IT and OT cybersecurity testbed coupled with a digital twin for monitoring, experimentation, and validation of countermeasures. The testbed emulates a central server, Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, SCADA-based infrastructure, and segmented IT, OT, and DMZ networks. It supports controlled cyberattack execution, software-patch evaluation, and training of RL-based defense agents. The testbed is further extended to a digital twin that models the real-time state of the environment using log and network statistics and enables bidirectional interaction through command execution and container lifecycle orchestration. Modbus/TCP and FHIR/HL7 support realistic communication across healthcare and industrial components. Experimental evaluation shows low computation overhead, with average normalized CPU utilization below 0.4 % per container and most lightweight services operating below 0.01%. OpenPLC Modbus TCP operations achieve a median round-trip latency of 0.901 ms. The testbed also captures a multi-stage SSH-based attack propagating from the DMZ to the IT and PLC networks. The framework provides a foundation for extending the emulated environment toward a hardware-enabled hospital digital twin.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 现代医院日益依赖IT与OT融合的基础设施来支撑关键医疗服务，但这一融合显著扩大了网络安全攻击面，且在真实系统上安全地验证防御机制十分困难。现有测试床多局限于单独的IT或OT环境，难以真实反映医院中跨域医疗交互的复杂性。为此，本文提出一个面向医院IT/OT环境的网络安全测试床，并耦合数字孪生系统，用于监控、实验和验证安全对策。测试床模拟了中央服务器、电子健康记录（EHR）系统、基于SCADA的基础设施，以及分割的IT、OT和DMZ网络，支持受控网络攻击执行、软件补丁评估和基于强化学习（RL）的防御智能体训练。数字孪生扩展部分通过日志和网络统计实时建模环境状态，并通过命令执行和容器生命周期编排实现双向交互。通信层面采用Modbus/TCP和FHIR/HL7协议，以模拟医疗与工业组件间的真实通信。实验结果显示，该平台计算开销较低：每个容器的平均归一化CPU利用率低于0.4%，大多数轻量级服务低于0.01%；OpenPLC Modbus TCP操作的中位往返时延为0.901毫秒。此外，测试床成功捕获了一次从DMZ传播至IT和PLC网络的多阶段SSH攻击。该框架为将模拟环境进一步扩展至硬件使能的医院数字孪生奠定了基础。本文的研究贡献在于提供一个集成化、可交互的测试平台，使安全分析与防御验证能够在真实感强且隔离可控的环境中进行，适用于医院IT/OT安全研究、蓝队演练以及自动化防御智能体的训练与评估。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 医院IT/OT融合是当前关键基础设施安全的焦点。该测试床提供了可重复的安全实验环境，能真实模拟跨域攻击路径，优于孤立IT或OT测试床，对蓝队理解医院网络攻击与验证防御策略具有直接借鉴价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至其他关键基础设施（如电力、水务）的IT/OT测试床设计，也可用于训练安全智能体和评估补丁影响，对SOC建设有参考意义。

items.title: Unclonable encryption from BB84 states: a simultaneous Goldreich-Levin reduction
items.summary: Goldreich-Levin reductions are ubiquitous in cryptography: they convert an algorithm capable of guessing $\langle r, m \rangle$ (mod $2$) for a hidden string $m$ and a random challenge $r$, to one that is capable of extracting the entirety of $m$. Here, we describe a "simultaneous" Goldreich-Levin reduction for two entangled parties who are capable of guessing $\langle r, m \rangle$ given uniformly random identical challenges $r$. This allows to upgrade any unclonable encryption scheme satisfying "search" security to one satisfying the gold standard of unclonable "indistinguishability". As a corollary, we show that the simplest candidate unclonable encryption scheme from BB84 states satisfies unclonable indistinguishability. This result was discovered by GPT-5.6 Ultra after a few interactions. Our prompts included recent results on unclonable encryption by Ananth and Sahai, and Ragavan.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇量子密码学领域的理论研究，由 Andrea Coladangelo、Qipeng Liu 和 Ziyi Xie 合作完成。论文的核心贡献在于提出了一种“同时式 Goldreich-Levin 归约”方法，该归约适用于两个纠缠的参与方，他们能够在给定相同均匀随机挑战 r 的情况下，猜测隐藏位串 m 与 r 的内积 <r,m> mod 2。传统 Goldreich-Levin 归约是密码学中的基础工具，可以将一个能够以非平凡优势猜测内积的算法转化为能够完整提取隐藏串 m 的算法。本文将其推广到双量子纠缠场景，实现了一种‘同时’归约，使得可以从未克隆加密方案的‘搜索安全性’升级为更强的‘不可区分安全性’——这是未克隆加密中最高标准的安全性概念。作为推论，作者证明了基于 BB84 态的最简单候选未克隆加密方案满足未克隆不可区分性。有趣的是，论文在摘要中声称该结果是由 GPT-5.6 Ultra 在几次交互后发现的，并且提示中包含了 Ananth、Sahai 和 Ragavan 关于未克隆加密的最新成果。本文适合对量子密码学、未克隆加密理论以及 Goldreich-Levin 归约技术感兴趣的密码学研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为未克隆加密方案的安全证明提供了新的归约技术，将搜索安全性自动提升为不可区分安全性，简化并强化了现有构造，对量子密码学理论有重要推进。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为未克隆加密方案的安全证明提供了新的归约技术，将搜索安全性自动提升为不可区分安全性，简化并强化了现有构造，对量子密码学理论有重要推进。

items.title: Towards the Impossibility of Imperfectly Complete Key Agreement in the QROM
items.summary: We make progress towards the impossibility of imperfectly complete quantum-computation, classical-communication (QCCC) key agreement by constructing the first unconditional attacks on quantum key agreement in the following restricted settings. In the two-message setting, we assume that Alice makes only classical queries to the oracle in the first round and that her message to Bob is classical, but otherwise both parties may perform arbitrary quantum computation, make quantum queries, and send a quantum state in the second round. Our attack and analysis are based on the heavy-query learning techniques from Austrin et al. (CRYPTO 2022) and the reprogramming techniques of Katz and Sela (arXiv 2401.14319). In the round-independent setting, we show that the attack of Barak and Mahmoody (CRYPTO 2009; J. Cryptology 2017) can be extended to multiple rounds when Alice and Bob share classical communication and make only classical queries in all but the final round. In both settings, the attacker is computationally unbounded and makes $poly(λ)$ queries to recover the key whenever each honest query bound is at most $poly(λ)$ and the valid agreement probability is inverse-polynomial. As a consequence, we rule out imperfectly correct quantum public-key encryption for classical messages whose length is bounded by a polynomial in $λ$ in the QROM when key generation has classical oracle access, even if encryption, decryption, and the ciphertext are quantum. In particular, the one-bit case applies to the imperfectly correct PKE obtained from two-round OSP by Bartusek and Khurana (CRYPTO 2025) whenever the classical OSP sender makes only classical random-oracle queries.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文研究量子计算与经典通信（QCCC）背景下不完全完全密钥协商的不可能性。所谓不完全完全，是指合法参与者以逆多项式概率成功协商密钥，而非必然成功。作者在两种受限制的设定中构建了首个无条件攻击。在两消息设定中，假设 Alice 在第一轮仅对预言机进行经典查询，且发送给 Bob 的消息是经典的；但双方可进行任意量子计算、在第二轮发送量子态并做量子查询。攻击与分析基于 Austrin 等人（CRYPTO 2022）的重查询学习技术，以及 Katz 和 Sela（arXiv 2401.14319）的重编程技术。在轮次无关设定中，作者将 Barak 和 Mahmoody（CRYPTO 2009；J. Cryptology 2017）的攻击扩展到多轮，此时 Alice 和 Bob 共享经典通信，且除最后一轮外仅进行经典查询。两种设定下，攻击者计算能力无界，只要每方诚实查询次数有界为 poly(λ)，且有效协商概率为逆多项式，攻击者即可通过 poly(λ) 次查询恢复密钥。作为推论，作者排除了 QROM 中不完全正确的量子公钥加密（PKE）：当密钥生成仅具有经典预言机访问时，即使加密、解密和密文均为量子，任何明文长度为 λ 多项式的 PKE 都不可能。特别地，一位情形适用于 Bartusek 和 Khurana（CRYPTO 2025）从两轮 OSP 构造的不完全正确 PKE，只要经典的 OSP 发送者仅进行经典随机预言机查询。该结果显著推进了对量子密钥协商可证明安全边界的理解，为后量子密码设计提供了新的不可能性约束。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该结果在量子随机预言机模型下划定了密钥协商和公钥加密的可证明安全性边界，直接影响后量子密码协议设计与标准化。理解这些不可能性可帮助蓝队避免选用理论上不安全的量子安全方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对依赖不完全正确量子 PKE 或相关 OSP 构造的系统构成理论层面的安全性影响，并提示在未来抗量子密码方案中需考虑经典预言机访问带来的攻击面。

items.why_it_matters: 该结果在量子随机预言机模型下划定了密钥协商和公钥加密的可证明安全性边界，直接影响后量子密码协议设计与标准化。理解这些不可能性可帮助蓝队避免选用理论上不安全的量子安全方案。

items.title: HarnessRisk: A Lifecycle-Oriented Benchmark for Agent Harness Safety
items.summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed through agent harnesses that manage tools, extensions, persistent state, permissions, and external actions. Existing safety benchmarks mainly target individual attack mechanisms or a limited subset of operational settings, making it difficult to compare how safety failures emerge across different harness responsibilities. We present HarnessRisk, a lifecycle oriented benchmark that organizes agent harness safety into six operational phases including Harness Configuration, Capability Extension, Runtime Operation, State Persistence, Action Control, and Incident Recovery. HarnessRisk contains 128 sandboxed cases, each pairing a benign user objective with an adversarial instruction embedded in an untrusted workflow artifact. We evaluate each trajectory using Utility, Attack Success Rate, Persistence, and Detection. Across three harnesses, six language models, and 14 model and harness configurations, attack success ranges from 12.6% to 80.9%, while Utility remains between 75.0% and 97.6%. Harness Configuration is the most vulnerable phase across all three harnesses, showing that attacks can succeed by altering security sensitive parameters within otherwise authorized workflows. We also find that explicit risk recognition does not reliably lead to safe action, as some configurations detect risks in more than 90% of runs while retaining substantial attack success. These results highlight the need to evaluate agent safety across multiple harness responsibilities and at the level of the deployed model and harness configuration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了 HarnessRisk，一个面向大语言模型（LLM）智能体框架安全性的生命周期导向基准。随着 LLM 越来越多地通过智能体框架（agent harness）来管理工具、扩展、持久化状态、权限和外部操作，现有安全基准大多针对单个攻击机制或有限的运行设置，难以系统比较不同框架职责下安全失效的涌现模式。HarnessRisk 将智能体框架安全划分为六个运营阶段：框架配置（Harness Configuration）、能力扩展（Capability Extension）、运行时操作（Runtime Operation）、状态持久化（State Persistence）、动作控制（Action Control）和事件恢复（Incident Recovery）。基准包含 128 个沙箱化测试用例，每个用例将一个良性用户目标与嵌入在不可信工作流工件中的对抗性指令配对。作者使用效用（Utility）、攻击成功率（Attack Success Rate）、持久性（Persistence）和检测（Detection）四个指标评估每次轨迹。在三个框架、六个语言模型和 14 种模型与框架配置组合的实验中，攻击成功率在 12.6% 到 80.9% 之间变化，而效用保持在 75.0% 到 97.6% 之间。结果显示框架配置是三个框架中最脆弱的阶段，表明在原本授权的流程中修改安全敏感参数即可导致攻击成功。此外，研究发现风险识别与安全行动之间并不总是可靠关联：某些配置在超过 90% 的运行中检测到风险，但仍然保持了相当高的攻击成功率。这些结果凸显了需要在多个框架职责层面以及部署的模型和框架配置级别评估智能体安全性的必要性。本文适合 LLM 安全研究者、智能体框架开发者以及负责 AI 系统安全评估的蓝队人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准首次系统覆盖智能体框架的完整生命周期，揭示框架配置阶段的高脆弱性，以及“识别风险但未采取安全行动”的普遍现象，为蓝队评估 LLM 智能体部署安全提供了可复用的测试方法和量化指标。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有基于 LLM 的 Agent 框架（如 AutoGPT、LangChain 等）的安全评估与加固，尤其对框架配置、权限管理和状态持久化等环节的安全设计有直接指导意义。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体框架中安全敏感参数被非授权修改的行为
检测机制触发但未阻断攻击执行的高风险配置组合
defense_advice_zh: 对框架配置阶段实施最小权限原则，并对敏感参数变更进行强校验
建立“检测-响应”联动机制，确保风险识别后自动阻断或降权
在部署前对模型与框架组合进行多阶段安全穿透测试

items.title: The Last Mile of Deepfake Speech Detection: An Industry-Academia Experience Report
items.summary: Synthetic speech detection benchmarks now report sub-1% error rates on some in-domain evaluations, yet performance degrades under unseen attacks, channel mismatch, and distribution shift. Based on a three-year effort with Phonexia, a commercial speaker-recognition vendor, we report barriers encountered while building and deploying a detector. Many public benchmarks are not licensed for commercial model development. Real inputs are not four-second clean clips but long, codec-degraded, sometimes partially synthetic recordings. And when a calibrated system returns a log-likelihood ratio of 2.5, no one can tell the customer what it means for their decision. Rather than proposing a new model, we connect these barriers to concrete research and coordination proposals: shared standards for commercially usable datasets, realistic deployment benchmarks, and scores that non-experts can act on. These observations come from one project and should be tested in other settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇工业界与学术界联合撰写的经验报告，聚焦深度伪造语音检测技术从实验室走向真实部署时的“最后一公里”问题。研究背景是：当前检测模型在领域内评测集上错误率已低于1%，但在面对未知攻击、信道失配和分布偏移时性能显著下降。作者基于与商业说话人识别厂商 Phonexia 长达三年的合作，报告了在构建和部署检测器过程中遇到的三类关键障碍。第一，许多公开基准数据集不允许用于商业模型开发，导致工业界难以合法利用学术界的数据资源。第二，真实场景输入并非标准化的四秒干净音频片段，而是长时间、经编解码器压缩退化、有时部分为合成内容的录音，这大大增加了检测难度。第三，即使系统经过校准并输出对数似然比2.5，客户也无法理解该分数对其实际决策的意义，说明现有评分体系缺乏可解释性和可操作性。本文并未提出新模型，而是将这些障碍转化为具体的研究与协调建议：建立商业可用的共享数据标准、设计更贴近部署环境的基准测试、发展非专家也能理解的分数表达方式。作者强调这些观察来源于单一项目，需要在其他场景中进一步验证。核心贡献在于系统性地梳理了学术基准与工业部署之间的鸿沟，并提出了可执行的改进方向，适合从事音频取证、深度伪造检测、AI系统可靠性研究的学者，以及需要部署语音反欺诈系统的安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 深度伪造语音检测的学术指标繁荣与真实部署效果之间存在巨大落差，本文揭示了数据许可、实际输入复杂性和评分可解释性等被忽视的工程瓶颈，对安全团队评估和落地检测系统有直接参考价值。

items.title: AdaRare: Telemetry-Guided Joint Profile Control for Greybox Fuzzing
items.summary: Greybox fuzzers combine interacting queue, mutation, dictionary, energy, and comparison-solving control surfaces, while prior adaptive systems typically optimize other decision objects or control layers. We present AdaRare, an AFL++ extension that coordinates five internal actuation mechanisms as one bounded in-process profile updated every 5,000 ms. Completed-window, action-induced telemetry feeds an arm-local recency-weighted linear scorer and a profile-conditioned controller target. The scorer borrows the algebraic structure of disjoint LinUCB, but serves as a closed-loop profile-ranking mechanism rather than a calibrated contextual-bandit action-value estimator or statistical confidence bound. Across three sequential repeated-trial phases, Main provides broad integrated-system evidence: AdaRare has higher median edge coverage than vanilla AFL++ on all eight targets, with five Holm-significant comparisons. In the strongest matched result, Full AdaRare has higher median edge coverage than CmpLog-matched AFL++ on all five follow-up targets, with four Holm-significant comparisons. Batch A finds higher medians for telemetry-guided selection than fixed-context, random, and round-robin schedules in all 15 target-control comparisons, with 13 Holm-significant comparisons. The experiments do not establish independent No-A6-versus-Shadow or scarcity-bundle effects; A6 evidence is target-dependent and weakens under batch-wide correction. In an unmatched firmware case study, AdaRare-generated inputs exposed five distinct memory-corruption findings, each reproduced in a separate environment and later assigned a CVE identifier. Controller-boundary compute P99 medians are below 6.5 ms for a five-second window; complete-boundary P99 medians including synchronous logging are below 14.7 ms. These measurements characterize boundary latency, not total system overhead.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 灰盒模糊测试器（如 AFL++）通常结合了交互队列、变异、字典、能量分配和比较求解等多个控制面，但以往的自适应系统往往只是优化其中某一个控制层或决策对象。本文提出 AdaRare，一个基于 AFL++ 的扩展，它协调五种内部驱动机制，将其作为一个有界的进程内配置文件，每隔 5000 毫秒更新一次。AdaRare 利用已完成窗口的遥测数据（即由动作引发的反馈）来训练一个臂局部（arm-local）的、基于近期加权线性评分器，并结合一个受配置文件约束的控制器目标。该评分器虽然借用了 disjoint LinUCB 的代数结构，但本质上是闭环的配置文件排序机制，而非真正的上下文 bandit 动作价值估计器或统计置信边界。实验分为三个连续阶段：主阶段中，AdaRare 在全部 8 个目标上相比原始 AFL++ 取得了更高的中位边覆盖率，其中 5 个比较具有 Holm 显著性；完整版 AdaRare 在 5 个后续目标上相比 CmpLog 匹配的 AFL++ 均表现出更高的中位边覆盖率，其中 4 个比较具有 Holm 显著性；批次 A 实验显示，在全部 15 个目标-控制比较中，遥测引导的选择策略优于固定上下文、随机和轮询调度，其中 13 个比较具有 Holm 显著性。然而，实验并未独立证明 No-A6 与 Shadow 或 scarcity-bundle 的效应，A6 的证据依赖于具体目标，并且在全批次校正后有所减弱。在一个非匹配的固件案例分析中，AdaRare 生成的输入暴露了 5 个不同的内存破坏缺陷，每个缺陷都在独立环境中复现并获得 CVE 编号。性能开销方面，五秒窗口下控制器边界的计算 P99 中位数低于 6.5 毫秒，包含同步日志的完整边界 P99 中位数低于 14.7 毫秒，说明其延迟可控。总体而言，AdaRare 通过遥测引导的联合配置控制，在多种目标上一致提升了灰盒模糊测试的覆盖率和漏洞发现能力，且计算开销很小。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 防御者可以借此了解自适应模糊测试的最新进展：通过联合调优多个内部控制面，可显著提升漏洞发现效率。该研究为下一代自动化安全测试工具提供了可借鉴的设计思路，有助于强化内部软件的模糊测试能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该研究主要影响灰盒模糊测试工具的配置效率和覆盖能力，可迁移到固件、物联网设备、桌面软件等漏洞挖掘场景，有潜力集成到 CI/CD 流水线中提升自动化安全测试产出。

items.title: Reflex-Guard: A Low-Latency Guardrail for LLM Prompt Safety Using Dense Semantic Embeddings
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world applications often face the risks of specially crafted prompts designed to bypass the safety controls. Existing guardrail methods, such as LLM-as-a-judge and cloud-based safety APIs are able to detect unsafe content. However, they often add a delay of about 250-900 ms to each request. This delay is too high for real-time applications, when the system usually needs to respond in less than 100 ms. Furthermore, routing user prompts through external moderation endpoints raises significant data privacy concerns. This paper introduces Reflex-Guard, a lightweight guardrail that runs locally. It uses jailbreak-aware preprocessing, compact sentence-transformer embeddings, and seven fast binary classifiers. Together, these components enable high-accuracy prompt safety filtering with much lower latency than existing solutions. Through systematic evaluation on a strategically balanced dataset of 30,568 samples drawn from five complementary sources, we demonstrate that Reflex-Guard achieves 95.9% recall on harmful prompts at 37.6 ms end-to-end latency. It is faster than existing baselines, including Llama Guard 2 at 255 ms and SafeDecoding at 723 ms. It can detect 100% of GCG suffix attacks and Base64-encoded prompts using the default threshold. However, DrAttack structured prompts required lowering the threshold to 0.03 for optimal detection, as they produced a distinct probability distribution. Reflex-Guard achieves Reflex Efficiency Score (RES) scores up to 16.79, significantly outperforming Llama Guard 2 (11.90) and SafeDecoding (9.80). This analysis offers practical deployment advice and shows that different attack types occupy distinct regions in the embedding probability space.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在实际应用中面临的安全防护挑战，提出了一种名为 Reflex-Guard 的低延迟本地防护方案。现有防护方法如 LLM-as-a-judge 或基于云的安全 API 虽能有效检测不安全内容，但每次请求会引入约 250-900 毫秒的延迟，难以满足实时系统通常要求的 100 毫秒内响应，同时将用户提示词路由到外部审核端点还会引发数据隐私担忧。Reflex-Guard 完全在本地运行，结合了针对越狱攻击的预处理、紧凑型句子变换器嵌入以及七个快速二分类器，在保持高精度的前提下显著降低延迟。在包含 30,568 个样本、来源覆盖五个互补数据集的均衡数据集上，系统评估显示 Reflex-Guard 对有害提示词的召回率达到 95.9%，端到端延迟仅为 37.6 毫秒，远快于 Llama Guard 2（255 毫秒）和 SafeDecoding（723 毫秒）。对于 GCG 后缀攻击和 Base64 编码提示，在默认阈值下可达到 100% 检测率；而 DrAttack 结构化提示因产生不同的概率分布，需将阈值降低至 0.03 以获得最佳检测效果。Reflex-Guard 的 Reflex 效率得分（RES）高达 16.79，显著优于 Llama Guard 2（11.90）和 SafeDecoding（9.80）。此外，分析表明不同攻击类型在嵌入概率空间中占据不同区域，可为实际部署提供策略性建议。该研究对需要低延迟、高隐私保护的 LLM 安全场景具有参考价值，适合关注提示词安全、防护性能优化及本地部署方案的模型开发者、安全工程师和研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为实时 LLM 应用提供了一种低至 37.6ms 的本地提示词安全过滤方案，解决了云端 API 延迟高和隐私泄露问题，同时展示了不同越狱攻击在嵌入空间中的分布特征，有助于蓝队设计更高效的防护策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于需要毫秒级响应的聊天机器人、实时内容审核、本地化 LLM 部署等场景；其嵌入空间分析方法也可迁移到其他安全检测任务中。
detection_signals_zh: 提示词嵌入概率分布中出现异常区域（类似 DrAttack 对应的分布特征）
检测日志中阈值需要调整以识别结构化的对抗性提示
defense_advice_zh: 在延迟敏感且数据隐私要求高的场景下，优先考虑本地化的轻量级防护方案
根据攻击类型动态调整分类阈值，以覆盖不同概率空间的攻击样本

items.title: Software Defined Networks Key Relay for Large-Scale Quantum Key Distribution Networks
items.summary: This work addresses the orchestration of large-scale Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKDNs) using Software Defined Networking (SDN). Building on ETSI and ITU specifications, common best practices and architectures are outlined. The main task of the SDN Controller is to aggregate technical key performance indicators (KPI) from the network and, based on these, select the optimal path. Multiple path selection algorithms, based on Dijkstra or a maximum-minimum capacity algorithm, with built-in load balancing are presented. The algorithms were tested in simulations and their performances, and tradeoffs, are discussed. Additional critical aspects related to SDN controlled QKDNs are discussed, such as query batching, multi-path selection and group key capabilities. An oblivious multi-party protocol is proposed for relay path selection in a multi-domain scenario, so providers don't have to disclose sensitive information about their QKDN. These contributions aim to enhance scalability, resilience and interoperability in quantum-secure network infrastructures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了基于软件定义网络（SDN）的大规模量子密钥分发网络（QKDN）的编排问题。随着量子安全网络的发展，QKDN 需要在复杂环境中实现高效、安全的密钥分发，而传统静态配置难以满足动态性和规模要求。作者依据 ETSI 和 ITU 相关规范，梳理了 QKDN 的常见最佳实践和体系架构，并指出 SDN 控制器的核心任务是聚合全网技术关键绩效指标（KPI），为每条密钥请求选择最优路径。针对该问题，作者提出了多种路径选择算法，包括基于 Dijkstra 的最短路径变体和一种最大最小容量算法，并在算法中内置负载均衡机制，以避免网络拥塞或局部过载。通过模拟实验，论文展示了这些算法的性能差异与权衡，为实际部署提供了参考。此外，文章还探讨了与 SDN 控制 QKDN 相关的若干关键特性，如查询批处理、多路径选择以及组密钥能力，以提升密钥管理效率。针对跨运营商的多域场景，作者提出了一种不依赖可信第三方的 oblivious 多方计算协议，用于协同完成中继路径选择，使得各参与方无需泄露内部网络拓扑或性能敏感信息。这些工作综合起来，旨在增强量子安全网络基础设施的可扩展性、弹性和互操作性，并为后续 QKDN 与 SDN 融合的标准化与工程实现提供技术支撑。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对于安全从业者而言，QKDN 是未来量子安全通信的关键基础设施，其管理编排方式直接关乎密钥分发的可靠性。本文提出的 SDN 编排与隐私保护的路径选择方法，有助于建设多域可互操作的量子安全网络，对防御方规划量子时代网络架构具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响量子安全网络基础设施的设计与部署，特别是多域 QKDN 的路径选择机制和跨域协作模式；相关算法和协议可迁移至其他需要隐私保护的多方协同决策场景。

items.title: TENET: Telegram Mini App (in)security
items.summary: Telegram, with over 450 million daily active users, has introduced Mini Apps---web-based applications running directly within its client. However, this integration introduces notable security risks. As we demonstrate, many Mini Apps store authentication materials---such as session tokens and wallet mnemonic phrases---in plaintext on client devices, exposing users to unauthorized access, impersonation, and financial exploitation. While insecure client-side storage is a known risk in web applications, the Telegram Mini App ecosystem presents a uniquely dangerous combination of factors absent from prior work: no platform-level security review, no storage access restrictions, a financially motivated user base handling live cryptocurrency assets, and a WebView environment that offers weaker protections than standalone browsers. To investigate this threat, we present TENET, a purpose-built auditing tool whose design decisions---pattern selection, entropy thresholds, and charset validation---are grounded in the structural properties of the secrets targeted and empirically validated against a ground-truth dataset. We screened 61 Mini Apps using a stratified, popularity-weighted sampling strategy based on popularity. Of the 37 applications that met our processing criteria and were analyzed, 30 exhibited security flaws, which we classify into three severity tiers: plaintext storage, recoverable encryption, and replayable tokens. Notably, even Telegram's official Wallet exhibits a severe vulnerability that may lead to full account compromise. Following our responsible disclosure, Telegram implemented two new secure-storage APIs, and our post-remediation verification confirmed that its official Wallet no longer exposes the recovery mnemonic in plaintext. Finally, we propose mitigation measures and best practices for both Telegram platform developers and third-party Mini App creators.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究Telegram Mini App生态的安全问题。Telegram拥有超过4.5亿日活用户，其Mini App是直接在客户端内运行的Web应用，但这一集成引入了显著的安全风险。研究发现，许多Mini App将认证材料（如会话令牌和钱包助记词）以明文形式存储在客户端设备上，导致未授权访问、身份冒充和金融损失。与普通Web应用不同，Telegram Mini App生态具有独特且危险的组合：无平台级安全审查、无存储访问限制、用户群体涉及真实加密货币资产、以及WebView环境防护弱于独立浏览器。为了系统调查此威胁，作者开发了TENET——一款专用审计工具，其设计（模式选择、熵阈值、字符集校验）基于目标秘密的结构属性，并通过真值数据集进行实证验证。作者采用基于流行度的分层抽样策略筛选了61个Mini App，其中37个满足处理标准并完成分析，30个存在安全缺陷，分为三个严重级别：明文存储、可恢复加密、可重放令牌。特别地，Telegram官方钱包也存在严重漏洞，可能导致账户完全被盗。在负责任披露后，Telegram实现了两个新的安全存储API，作者验证官方钱包不再明文暴露恢复助记词。最后，文章为Telegram平台开发者和第三方Mini App创建者提出了缓解措施和最佳实践。本文首次系统性地揭示Mini App生态的特有安全问题，并提供了可用的自动化审计工具和平台改进建议。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Mini App生态是新兴攻击面，明文存储助记词和令牌可导致大规模加密货币资产被盗。Telegram官方钱包的漏洞证明即使是平台自带应用也不安全，安全从业者需关注此类嵌入式Web环境的风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用Telegram Mini App的用户，尤其是涉及加密货币钱包、支付等敏感功能的场景。发现的漏洞类型可直接映射到身份认证和资产保护机制。

items.title: SoK: Cross-Chain Transaction Identification and Matching
items.summary: Cross-chain bridges, instant cryptocurrency exchanges, and centralized cross-ledger platforms move assets across an increasingly multi-chain ecosystem. However, these systems have repeatedly become targets of high-value attacks and channels for cross-chain money laundering. Cross-chain transactions are substantially harder to analyze than single-chain transactions: no single ledger records an entire cross-chain transfer, its evidence is scattered across the source chain, the destination chain, and off-chain systems, and the availability and reliability of that evidence vary widely across systems. In this paper, we present a systematization of knowledge (SoK) on cross-chain transaction identification and matching. First, we classify deposit and withdrawal identification methods into four approaches and transaction matching methods into three mechanisms: deterministic identifier matching, field-constraint heuristics, and model-assisted matching. We find that their applicability and reported performance are shaped mainly by the evidence the underlying system exposes, and we further examine how matched pairs support downstream attack detection and fund tracing. Second, we assess the availability of existing datasets and artifacts, finding that fewer than half remain obtainable, and distill three artifact failure modes. Finally, we outline four open challenges toward auditable, reproducible, and actionable cross-chain analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文由 Zheng 等人撰写，旨在系统化梳理跨链交易识别与匹配的研究现状。研究背景在于跨链生态的快速增长带来了安全与合规难题，而现有分析工具难以应对跨链数据的分散性与异构性。核心贡献包括：(1) 提出了一个分类框架，将存取款识别方法分为基于地址映射、基于交易模式、基于智能合约事件和基于链下信息等四类；将交易匹配分为确定性标识符匹配（如使用同一哈希）、字段约束启发式（如金额与时间窗口）和模型辅助匹配（如机器学习分类）。(2) 基于对多篇论文的系统调研，总结了不同方法的应用场景、前提假设以及报告的精度/召回率，并指出这些方法高度依赖于系统公开的证据类型。(3) 对公开数据集和开源工件进行了可用性审计，发现由于链接失效、版本更新和依赖缺失等原因，超过一半的工件无法获取，这严重限制了可复现性。(4) 结合匹配后的交易对，探讨了在攻击检测（如闪电贷攻击、盗币转移）和资金追踪（如混币器关联）中的应用。(5) 提出了四大开放挑战：跨链身份统一、证据标准化、数据集维护机制、以及模型可解释性。该 SoK 为安全研究人员和执法机构提供了跨链分析的路线图。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 跨链交易分析是区块链安全与合规的关键环节。本文系统化梳理了识别与匹配方法，帮助从业者理解不同技术的优劣与适用性，避免盲目选择，为追踪跨链洗钱和攻击溯源提供方法论指导。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于跨链安全监控、事件响应、资金溯源和监管审计场景，也可为交易所和桥接协议的风险评估提供参考。
defense_advice_zh: 采用多种匹配机制交叉验证跨链交易
建立证据链的完整性与可用性审计机制

items.title: CryptDough: A Unified Analytics Engine for Secure Multiparty Computation
items.summary: We present CryptDough, a unified analytics engine for secure multiparty computation (MPC). CryptDough enables multiple distrusting parties to jointly execute a data analysis pipeline on their private inputs and learn nothing beyond the result (e.g., aggregate statistics). Unlike existing MPC solutions that support a single threat model or workload type, CryptDough provides built-in support for cross-domain analytics (relational, time series, ML inference) under various threat models, all within the same system runtime. CryptDough contributes (i) a hierarchical system design that facilitates modularity and extensibility through progressive lowering of abstractions, and (ii) the concept of virtual vectors that enable users to write single-threaded code across all layers of the software stack, while pushing the complexity of communication, parallelization, and memory management down to the execution engine. We show that CryptDough generalizes the functionality of state-of-the-art MPC systems and remains competitive on the analytics they support, often outperforming them by more than $2\times$.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 CryptDough，一个用于安全多方计算（MPC）的统一分析引擎。在传统 MPC 方案中，每个系统往往只支持单一威胁模型或特定工作负载类型，难以满足企业在隐私保护下进行跨领域数据分析的多样化需求。CryptDough 通过分层系统设计，将关系分析、时间序列分析和机器学习推理统一到同一运行时环境中，允许多个不信任的参与方在私有输入上共同执行分析流水线，且除了最终结果（如聚合统计）外不学习任何其他信息。其核心创新包括：（1）通过逐步降低抽象层级实现模块化与可扩展性，使系统能够灵活适应不同威胁模型和计算需求；（2）引入“虚拟向量”概念，让用户可以在整个软件栈的各层编写单线程代码，而将通信、并行化和内存管理的复杂性下沉到执行引擎，从而大幅降低开发门槛。实验表明，CryptDough 不仅能覆盖现有 MPC 系统的功能范围，还在其支持的分析任务上保持竞争力，通常可获得 2 倍以上的性能提升。该工作为隐私保护数据分析提供了更通用、更易用的基础设施，适合对隐私计算、安全多方计算或联合分析感兴趣的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: CryptDough 为安全多方计算提供统一的运行时，降低了隐私保护数据分析的工程复杂度，有助于蓝队和安全工具在跨机构数据协作中实现可审计的隐私计算，减少因使用不成熟的定制 MPC 方案带来的安全风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于隐私保护的数据联合分析、联邦学习、恶意流量检测中的特征共享等场景，也可为安全运营提供基于 MPC 的聚合统计和模型推理基础设施。
defense_advice_zh: 关注 MPC 系统自身的密钥管理、通信协议实现和代码审计；在部署 CryptDough 时验证其威胁模型配置与数据分片策略。
建议对参与方的输入输出进行差分隐私保护，防止通过结果反推敏感个体信息。

items.why_it_matters: CryptDough 为安全多方计算提供统一的运行时，降低了隐私保护数据分析的工程复杂度，有助于蓝队和安全工具在跨机构数据协作中实现可审计的隐私计算，减少因使用不成熟的定制 MPC 方案带来的安全风险。

items.title: Cross-Domain Joint DDoS Detection in Multi-Controller SDN via Confidence-Based Entropy Fusion
items.summary: In multi-controller Software-Defined Networking (SDN), Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks exhibit a "dispersed source, concentrated target" pattern across domains, i.e., attack traffic originates from multiple edge-controller domains but converges on a victim in a single aggregation controller domain. While entropy-based DDoS detectors are effective in single-controller settings, their direct application in multi-controller SDN reveals a previously overlooked anomaly. Through systematic experiments, we identify an aggregation bias: during the post-attack transition phase, the aggregation controller continues to generate excessive false positives, while edge controllers have already returned to normal. We attribute this phenomenon to the coupled effects of OpenFlow statistics lag and unconstrained dynamic-threshold drift. To address this issue, we propose a cross-domain confidence-fusion framework that leverages lightweight edge-side messages to calibrate aggregation-controller decisions without sharing raw traffic data. The framework is non-intrusive, communication-efficient, and incrementally deployable. Experiments on a three-controller linear Mininet testbed with 24 hosts over 10 runs show that the method preserves edge-controller performance while reducing the aggregation false positive rate from 8.87% to 1.96% and increasing the F1 score from 89.04% to 96.89%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对多控制器软件定义网络（SDN）中跨域分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击的检测问题展开研究。在多控制器SDN环境下，DDoS攻击呈现“分散源、集中目标”的跨域模式：攻击流量源自多个边缘控制器域，但最终汇聚到单一聚合控制器域的受害目标。传统基于熵的DDoS检测器在单控制器场景中效果良好，但直接应用于多控制器SDN时，作者通过系统实验发现了一个此前被忽视的异常现象——“聚合偏差”：在攻击后的过渡阶段，聚合控制器继续产生过多的误报，而边缘控制器已恢复正常。作者将该现象归因于OpenFlow统计信息滞后与非约束动态阈值漂移的耦合效应。为解决此问题，论文提出了一种跨域置信度融合框架，利用轻量级边缘侧消息来校准聚合控制器的决策，无需共享原始流量数据。该框架具有非侵入性、通信高效、可增量部署等优点。作者在包含3个控制器、24台主机的线性Mininet测试平台上进行了10次运行实验，结果表明该方法在保持边缘控制器性能的同时，将聚合控制器的误报率从8.87%降低至1.96%，F1分数从89.04%提升至96.89%。该研究为多控制器SDN环境下的DDoS检测提供了新的思路，适合网络运维人员、SDN安全研究者以及DDoS防护系统设计者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次揭示多控制器SDN中熵检测的聚合偏差问题，并提出轻量级跨域融合方案，显著降低误报，对实际SDN部署中的DDoS防护有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响多控制器SDN架构下的DDoS检测准确性，尤其是聚合控制器节点的误报率；方法可迁移至其他分布式网络监控场景。
defense_advice_zh: 关注OpenFlow统计延迟导致的阈值漂移问题，建议对聚合控制器的动态阈值加入约束或平滑机制。
可引入跨域轻量级消息融合机制，在保护隐私的前提下提升检测准确性。

items.why_it_matters: 首次揭示多控制器SDN中熵检测的聚合偏差问题，并提出轻量级跨域融合方案，显著降低误报，对实际SDN部署中的DDoS防护有直接参考价值。

items.title: KeyPooling: Measuring Where LLM API Relay Paths Collapse Prompt Cache Isolation
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) API relays authenticate customers separately but often forward requests through shared provider credentials. Providers scope prompt caches to upstream principals and namespaces, so relay customers mapped to one cache identity can observe each other's cache state. Prior work showed cache sharing at selected endpoints but did not identify which credential, pool, adapter, or nested hop controls the finalidentity. We present KeyPooling, a measurement method that traces customer identity through cache lookup and write, verifies runtime transformations, and tests one predicted identity component at a time. Across five open-source gateways connected to OpenAI and Anthropic, none bound customers to upstream credentials by default; under a shared credential, all five exposed cross-customer cache reads for both providers. Principal and namespace splits, pool associations, and adapter and nested-relay contrasts localized the controlling transformations. In an outcome-independent weekly OpenRouter frame, tests covered 80.5% of eligible token volume and found cross-account reads for 12 of 28 labels carrying 33.7% of volume. On one production route, a controlled procedure recovered eight consecutive target positions without target access. Broader tests identify cache granularity, routing, rate limits, attribution, and budget as conditions for token-by-token recovery, not security controls. We derive a defense contract: every customer must enter a provider-enforced domain, or a namespace derived from authenticated identity must survive every final cache lookup and write. Placing this split after reusable public prefixes preserved most modeled reuse at a 1.7-2.5% cost increase.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型（LLM）API 中继服务中的提示缓存隔离漏洞。中继服务通常对客户进行分别认证，但请求却通过共享的上游提供商凭据转发。提供商将提示缓存作用域限定到上游主体和命名空间，导致映射到同一缓存身份的中继客户能够观察彼此的缓存状态。先前研究仅在部分端点证实了缓存共享，但未明确是哪个凭据、池、适配器或嵌套跳转最终控制了缓存身份。为此，作者提出了 KeyPooling 测量方法：通过缓存查找和写入流程追踪客户身份，验证运行时转换，并逐一测试预测的身份组件。在五个连接到 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的开源网关上，实验表明默认情况下没有任何网关将客户绑定到独立的上游凭据；在共享凭据环境下，五个网关全部暴露了跨客户缓存读取。通过主体/命名空间拆分、池关联、适配器和嵌套中继对比，作者定位了控制身份转换的关键点。在结果独立的每周 OpenRouter 帧中，测试覆盖了 80.5% 的符合条件的 token 量，发现 28 个标签中的 12 个存在跨账户读取，占 33.7% 的流量。此外，在一个生产路由上，受控过程恢复了八个连续的目标位置而无需目标访问。更广泛测试表明，缓存粒度、路由、速率限制、归因和预算是逐 token 恢复的条件，而非安全控制。作者据此提出了防御契约：每个客户必须进入提供商强制执行的域，或由经过身份验证的身份派生的命名空间必须存活于每次最终缓存查找和写入。将该拆分置于可重用公共前缀之后，可以在 1.7-2.5% 成本增长下保留大部分模型重用收益。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了 LLM API 中继在共享凭据下的系统性缓存隔离缺陷，可能导致跨客户提示数据泄露，影响众多使用中继网关的企业和应用，需引起蓝队与架构师警惕。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用共享上游凭据的 LLM API 网关/代理服务（如开源网关和 OpenRouter 等），可能导致跨客户缓存读取、提示内容泄露及潜在敏感信息暴露，并可能被用于逐 token 恢复目标数据。
defense_advice_zh: 确保每个客户分配独立的上游凭据，或在最终缓存查找和写入前强制引入基于认证身份的命名空间拆分。
在可重用公共前缀之后实施命名空间拆分，以平衡安全性与缓存复用收益。
审计网关配置，确认默认情况下未将多个客户映射到同一缓存身份。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估自身LLM中继网关的缓存隔离配置，必要时实施命名空间拆分。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了 LLM API 中继在共享凭据下的系统性缓存隔离缺陷，可能导致跨客户提示数据泄露，影响众多使用中继网关的企业和应用，需引起蓝队与架构师警惕。
items.recommended_action: 研究跟进，评估自身LLM中继网关的缓存隔离配置，必要时实施命名空间拆分。

items.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services
items.summary: Most large language model services use stateless defenses, which judge only the current request, to refuse harmful tasks. Decomposition attacks exploit this limitation by splitting a harmful task into individually permissible requests and combining their answers. Defending against them therefore requires a stateful monitor that considers requests together. If it can group all requests for one attacker task, it can stop the attack. However, attackers can use unlinkable identities and combine answers elsewhere, leaving no reliable grouping signal. We ask whether decomposition attacks can still be stopped under this setting. For a fixed attack strategy without retries, we prove that the achievable security and utility tradeoff depends entirely on how benign requests for the same capabilities are grouped. Persistent, recognizable groups permit a useful defense; fresh, indistinguishable groups do not. When attackers can retry and learn from Allow/Block decisions, this useful operating point disappears: the feedback reveals what passes but not whether a block was correct. Experiments on 91 executable tasks and 11,393 capability-matched benign requests support these results. Under a 1% denial cap for these requests and a 0.5% cap for unrelated background traffic, all ten tested policies, including one privileged policy with an exact request-to-operation map, either fail to stop attacks or exceed the budget. On defense-unseen task families, attack success is at least 99% after one attempt and 100% after two. Effective defenses therefore require additional evidence or mechanisms tied to grouping, such as reliable identity linkage, costs for fresh identities, or control over answer use.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）服务在应对分解攻击（decomposition attacks）时的根本性安全限制。分解攻击将恶意任务拆分为多个看似无害的请求，每个请求单独判断均能通过无状态防御，但组合各请求的响应即可实现原始恶意目标。现有防御大多为无状态，仅检查当前请求，无法识别这种跨请求的协同恶意行为。要阻止分解攻击，需要引入有状态监控器，将同一攻击者的多个请求关联为同一任务组，并在组合完成前加以阻断。然而，攻击者可以利用不可关联的身份（unlinkable identities）发起请求，并在服务外部自行汇总答案，从而消除可靠的关联信号。本文的核心问题是：在攻击者使用不可关联身份的设定下，分解攻击是否仍能被有效阻止？作者从理论层面证明，对于固定攻击策略（无重试），可达到的安全性与效用贸易极限完全取决于良性请求如何按能力分组。若良性请求形成持久、可识别的分组，则存在可用的防御策略；若分组是新鲜且不可区分的，则无法构建有效防御。当攻击者允许重试并从允许/阻止反馈中学习时，原本可用的操作点也会消失：反馈只能告诉攻击者哪些请求通过，但不能告诉其阻止是否正确，导致防御失效。实验基于91个可执行任务和11,393个与能力匹配的良性请求，验证了上述结论。在良性请求拒绝率不超过1%、无关背景流量拒绝率不超过0.5%的限制下，全部十种测试策略（包括一种拥有请求到操作精确映射的特权策略）要么无法阻止攻击，要么超出预算。对防御者未见过的任务族，攻击成功率在一次尝试后至少为99%，两次尝试后为100%。因此，有效防御必须依赖与分组相关的额外证据或机制，例如可靠的身份关联、为新身份增加成本、或对答案使用进行控制。本文为LLM服务的安全设计提供了重要的理论边界，提示仅靠有状态监控而不解决身份关联性问题，无法彻底防御分解攻击。适合LLM安全研究者、服务提供商防御团队以及大模型安全策略制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM有状态防御的根本局限：即使引入状态监控，若攻击者使用不可关联身份，防御仍会失效。这为安全团队设计防御策略提供了理论依据，避免盲目依赖分组监控。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖无状态或仅有状态请求监控的LLM服务，具体场景包括恶意内容生成、越狱攻击、自动化社工等。需重新考虑身份关联和答案使用控制等安全机制。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了LLM有状态防御的根本局限：即使引入状态监控，若攻击者使用不可关联身份，防御仍会失效。这为安全团队设计防御策略提供了理论依据，避免盲目依赖分组监控。

items.title: FESC: Remodeling Long-Context Private Inference with Encrypted State-Space Models
items.summary: Processing long, sensitive documents with machine-learning models requires efficient, privacy-preserving long-context inference. Prior private inference systems optimize or distribute encrypted Transformer attention, but its quadratic token-pair work remains the bottleneck as sequence length grows. Selective state-space models (SSMs) offer linear-time recurrence, yet direct encrypted implementation incurs linear multiplicative depth, sequence-wide state residency, or dense FHE-MPC conversion. We present Factorized Encrypted Scan-Contract (FESC), a hybrid FHE-MPC system for private long-context selective SSM inference. Its factorized scan-contract keeps input-dependent transitions compact across conversion boundaries, composes them without dense expansion, streams state chunks on demand, and contracts outputs before conversion. We demonstrate interface compatibility of the scan-contract implementation across invariant and selective SSM architectures. For our Mamba-2 instantiation, we design GPU-optimized CKKS kernels for linear computations, MPC protocols for SiLU, softplus, exponential, and RMSNorm, with approximation-aware fine-tuning. To our knowledge, FESC is the first private long-document inference system to complete native end-to-end execution at $L \geq 1{,}024$ on a single GPU. At $L = 2{,}048$, a 12-layer Mamba-base model completes inference in 77.3 minutes on one A100 GPU with a peak memory footprint of 32.7 GB, while maintaining near-plaintext accuracy on the evaluated long-document tasks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文提出 FESC（Factorized Encrypted Scan-Contract），一种用于长上下文保密推理的混合 FHE-MPC 系统，面向具有线性时间复杂度的选择性状态空间模型（SSM）。背景上，处理长敏感文档需要兼顾效率和隐私，但既有私有推理系统主要针对 Transformer 注意力机制进行优化，其计算量随序列长度呈二次增长，成为长上下文场景的瓶颈。SSM 虽能实现线性时间递归，但直接将其移植到加密域会带来线性乘法深度、跨序列的状态驻留问题，以及频繁且密集的 FHE 与 MPC 转换开销。FESC 的核心创新在于引入“因子化扫描契约”机制，将依赖输入的状态转换保持紧凑表示，在转换边界处进行组合而不产生密集展开，按需流式传输状态块，并在转换前压缩输出。该设计同时兼容不变型和选择型 SSM 架构，具备接口通用性。作者以 Mamba-2 为实例，实现了 GPU 优化的 CKKS 同态加密内核，用于线性计算；并设计了针对 SiLU、softplus、exponential 和 RMSNorm 的 MPC 协议，配合近似感知微调以恢复精度。实验结果显示，FESC 是首个能够在单张 GPU 上以 L≥1024 的序列长度完成原生端到端私有推理的系统。在 L=2048 时，12 层 Mamba-base 模型在单张 A100 GPU 上的推理时间为 77.3 分钟，峰值内存占用 32.7 GB，且在所评估的长文档任务上保持接近明文模型的准确率。该工作表明，通过混合加密协议和模型协同设计，SSM 可以成为 Transformer 在隐私保护长文本处理中的可行替代方案。适合对隐私计算、同态加密、高效 ML 推理和长文档处理感兴趣的安全与系统研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为长文档隐私推理提供了 Transformer 之外的高效路线，显著降低密文计算复杂度，有望推动医疗、法律等敏感场景下大规模私有化文本分析的应用落地。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对依赖 Transformer 的现有私有推理体系构成潜在替代；其因子化扫描契约和混合加密流程可迁移至其他线性递归模型，并为 FHE/MPC 混合系统的工程优化提供参考。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为长文档隐私推理提供了 Transformer 之外的高效路线，显著降低密文计算复杂度，有望推动医疗、法律等敏感场景下大规模私有化文本分析的应用落地。

items.title: On the Pseudo-Mixing of Kac's Walk
items.summary: Motivated by a conjecture of Vaikuntanathan and Zamir, we study the pseudo-mixing of Kac's walk on $\mathrm{SO}(n)$: whether short trajectories are indistinguishable from Haar measure by low-complexity tests. We prove that the first $k$ columns mix in Wasserstein distance in $O(n(k+\log n)\log n)$ steps for fixed accuracy, resolving a conjecture of Oliveira. Combining this with a representation-theoretic variance bound, we show that if $T=ω(nk(k+\log n)\log n)$, then every degree-$k$ polynomial normalized to have unit Haar variance has expectation under the $T$-step law within $o(1)$ of its Haar expectation. As an application, we show that this pseudo-mixing estimate can be used to prove the effectiveness of a fast Johnson--Lindenstrauss transform with the usual target dimension.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究 Kac 游走（Kac's walk）在特殊正交群 SO(n) 上的“伪混合”性质。Kac 游走是一种随机过程，每一步随机选取两个坐标并施加一个随机旋转，常用于生成近似 Haar 测度的随机正交矩阵。Vaikuntanathan 和 Zamir 曾猜想：短时间轨迹上的低复杂度测试无法将其与 Haar 测度区分。作者针对此猜想展开研究，首先证明了前 k 列在固定精度下，经 O(n(k+log n)log n) 步后在 Wasserstein 距离上趋于 Haar 测度，解决了 Oliveira 提出的猜想。随后结合表示论中的方差界，证明若步数 T=ω(nk(k+log n)log n)，则所有单位 Haar 方差、次数不超过 k 的多项式在 T 步分布下的期望与其 Haar 期望相差 o(1)。这一结果刻画了低阶统计量在有限步内无法区分 Kac 游走与真实 Haar 测度，即“伪混合”现象。作为应用，作者将该伪混合估计用于证明快速 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 变换在常规目标维度下仍然有效。该论文属于概率论与理论计算机科学的交叉研究，核心贡献在于从理论和表示论角度强化了 Kac 游走的实用随机性边界，为依赖随机正交矩阵的算法（如随机投影、降维、数据保护）提供了更坚实的数学基础。适合对随机矩阵、马尔可夫链混合时间、降维算法以及密码学中随机性生成机制感兴趣的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Kac 游走是生成随机正交矩阵的高效方法，广泛应用于降维和加密场景。该研究证明了其短伪混合界，使低复杂度攻击在多项式时间内无法区分，为安全应用中的随机性生成提供了理论支撑。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 理论结果可迁移至随机投影类算法（如 JL 变换）及隐私保护中随机化机制的设计，有助于评估类似随机游走在安全场景中的适用边界。

items.title: Trusted Workflow Relays:Cross-Tenant Email Abuse and Composable Red Team Initial-Access Primitives in Multi-Tenant Clouds
items.summary: Cloud applications routinely send notifications through provider-operated mail identities, which improves deliverability but separates the actor who supplies notification parameters from the service principal that originates the message. In three responsibly disclosed and remediated cross-tenant notification workflows, an authenticated actor could reach recipients across tenant boundaries and, to varying degrees, control content that a trusted provider service delivered. In the first, backend requests bypassed a UI length limit, raw HTML and CSS survived into the delivered message, attacker links rendered, and CSS could hide service-controlled text; iframes and non-web URI schemes were rejected. The second combined missing recipient-tenant validation with attacker-controlled subject and HTML fields. The third, an approval application, added weak access control, sequential object identifiers, missing action authorization, and incomplete token validation, composing notification abuse with authorization failures. The pattern is analogous to a classical unauthenticated SMTP open relay, but the failure has moved up the stack: the actor is authenticated and the provider is the legitimate sender, yet application-layer authorization still fails to constrain who may cause it to send what to whom. We define a trusted workflow relay as a delivered, service-authentic message for which the application-level send-authorization predicate is false. We give a test matrix for notification pipelines, map the primitive to MITRE ATT&CK techniques for attachment-free phishing, and link it to device-code phishing (RFC 8628). SPF, DKIM, and DMARC can authenticate a message yet cannot establish that an application-level send was authorized. We conclude with controls for tenant binding, typed templates, object-level authorization, token audience validation, and identity telemetry.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究多租户云环境中一类新型的跨租户邮件滥用问题，称之为"受信任工作流中继"（Trusted Workflow Relays）。核心背景是：云应用通常通过提供商运营的邮件身份发送通知，这虽然提高了送达率，却将通知参数的提供者与实际产生消息的服务主体分离。作者在三个负责任披露并已修复的跨租户通知工作流中发现，经过身份验证的攻击者能够跨越租户边界触达收件人，并在不同程度上控制由受信任提供商服务投递的内容。第一个案例中，后端请求绕过了UI的长度限制，原始HTML和CSS存活到投递消息中，攻击者链接可渲染，且CSS能隐藏服务控制的文本；iframes和非Web URI方案被拒绝。第二个案例将缺失的接收方租户验证与攻击者控制的subject和HTML字段相结合。第三个案例是审批应用，存在弱访问控制、顺序对象标识符、缺失动作授权和不完整令牌验证，将通知滥用与授权失败组合在一起。作者指出该模式相当于经典的无认证SMTP开放中继，但故障已上移到应用层：攻击者是已认证的，提供商是合法发送者，但应用层授权仍然无法约束谁可以导致它向谁发送什么。论文定义了"受信任工作流中继"为一条已投递的、服务认证的消息，但其应用层发送授权谓词为假。作者为通知管道提供了一个测试矩阵，将该原语映射到MITRE ATT&CK中的无附件钓鱼技术，并关联到设备码钓鱼（RFC 8628）。文中强调SPF、DKIM、DMARC可以认证消息，却无法确立应用层发送是否被授权。最后给出关于租户绑定、类型化模板、对象级授权、令牌受众验证和身份遥测的防护建议。适合云安全架构师、SaaS提供商的安全团队以及研究应用层授权边界的人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了多租户云中"合法服务身份发送恶意内容"的盲区，绕过传统邮件认证体系，对钓鱼防护和租户隔离设计有直接警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖云提供商通知邮件的多租户SaaS应用；可能导致跨租户钓鱼、品牌冒充及授权绕过，可迁移到Webhook、短信通知等类似管道。
detection_signals_zh: 来自云服务提供商域名的邮件中出现非预期HTML/CSS或异常链接
同一服务身份发送的邮件内容结构突变或包含隐藏文本
通知邮件中接收方租户与发送方租户不匹配
defense_advice_zh: 对通知消息实施类型化模板，严格允许列表控制HTML标签和属性
在应用层强制发送授权验证，确保任何服务身份的调用方拥有明确权限
令牌校验必须包含受众(audience)和租户绑定确认

items.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets
items.summary: Reliable jailbreak evaluation is essential for assessing LLM safety, but most existing studies rely solely on attack success rate (ASR) without accounting for its dependence on attack budgets, resulting in unfair comparisons across methods. Existing compute-aware evaluations reduce heterogeneous resources into FLOPs, which is difficult to estimate for black-box models and fails to capture resource-specific constraints. To provide a comparable evaluation basis, we introduce Fair-ASR, an evaluation protocol for black-box jailbreak attacks under shared target-call budgets B, using target calls as a directly observable and method-agnostic comparison axis while tracking attacker calls separately for efficiency analysis. We re-evaluate 11 representative attacks under the Fair-ASR protocol and find that attack rankings change substantially across target-call budgets, simple stochastic perturbations and hand-crafted templates remain highly competitive under equal target access, and no evaluated LLM-driven method is efficient in both target and attacker calls. Motivated by this efficiency gap, we introduce ReCode, a compositional budget-efficient attack that combines desensitization rewriting with two effective low-cost primitives identified by Fair-ASR. Under a budget of 20 target calls, ReCode achieves 85% ASR on GPT-5 while requiring only 7.19 attacker calls per request on average, showing strong efficiency in both target and attacker calls.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新的黑盒大语言模型（LLM）越狱攻击评估协议 Fair-ASR，旨在解决现有评估中仅依赖攻击成功率（ASR）而忽视攻击预算导致的比较不公平问题。现有计算感知评估方法将异构资源折算为 FLOPs，但黑盒模型的 FLOPs 难以估计且无法反映资源特定约束。Fair-ASR 以共享目标调用预算 B 为统一比较基准，将目标调用次数作为直接可观察、与方法无关的对比轴，同时单独记录攻击者调用次数用于效率分析。作者在 Fair-ASR 协议下重新评估了 11 种代表性攻击，发现攻击排名会随目标调用预算变化而显著改变；简单的随机扰动和手工模板在同等目标访问下仍具竞争力；而所有已评估的基于 LLM 的攻击方法均无法同时在目标调用和攻击者调用上达到高效。基于这一效率差距，作者进一步提出了 ReCode，一种组合式预算高效攻击方法，它将脱敏重写与 Fair-ASR 识别的两种低成本原语相结合。在 20 次目标调用预算下，ReCode 在 GPT-5 上达到 85% 的 ASR，且平均每次请求仅需 7.19 次攻击者调用，展现出在目标调用和攻击者调用上的双重高效性。该工作为 LLM 越狱评估提供了更公平的基准，也为防御方理解攻击效率与预算之间的关系提供了参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为 LLM 越狱攻击评估提供了公平预算比较框架，避免被高 ASR 误导；对蓝队而言，理解攻击预算与成功率的真实关系有助于合理设计红队演练和模型安全基线。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 LLM 安全评估方法和红队实践，可迁移到各类黑盒 AI 系统的对抗鲁棒性测试与安全验收场景。
detection_signals_zh: 监控针对 LLM 的高频异常调用模式，尤其是短时间内大量相似请求
在评估中统一采用目标调用预算指标，避免单点 ASR 误判
defense_advice_zh: 采用 Fair-ASR 协议进行内部模型安全测试，确保攻击方法在预算约束下公平比较
关注简单随机扰动与手工模板带来的持续性风险，强化基础输入过滤和输出校准
对任何声称高 ASR 的攻击方法，要求其披露目标调用与攻击调用成本，避免盲目模型迭代

items.title: FlowShield: cryptocurrency anti-money laundering with transaction semantics parsing and fund flow tracking
items.summary: Cryptocurrency anti-money laundering (Crypto AML) is increasingly challenged by sophisticated laundering behaviors that rapidly fragment stolen assets through diverse semantics and across multiple blockchains. Existing Crypto AML methods often simplify transaction semantics, rely on topology-centric signals, or output isolated detection labels. In this paper, we present \textsc{FlowShield}, a Crypto AML framework for transaction-level laundering detection and investigator-facing report generation. \textsc{FlowShield} first recovers behavior-level semantics from observable relations, making laundering intents explicit. To trace value provenance and redistribution, \textsc{FlowShield} reconstructs fund-flow subgraphs from three complementary perspectives. It then employs a text--structure fusion mechanism, enabling the interplay between large language model (LLM)-encoded semantics and flow texts with graph convolutional network (GCN)-encoded structure. Beyond mere detection, \textsc{FlowShield} further generates readable suspicious activity reports (SARs), offering investigators concise summaries and explainable red flags. To address the data scarcity in multi-chain detection, we construct and open-source \textit{BybitML}, the first public multi-chain laundering dataset. We evaluate \textsc{FlowShield} on \textit{BybitML} and two public laundering datasets and experimental results demonstrate that \textsc{FlowShield} achieves the best overall performance, with an average F1 score of 98.0\%. Further behavior and SAR analyses demonstrate that \textsc{FlowShield} can reveal diverse laundering strategies and produce readable reports for investigating complex multi-hop fund flows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 加密货币反洗钱（Crypto AML）正面临日益复杂的洗钱手法，攻击者通过多种交易语义和多条区块链快速分割、转移被盗资产。现有方法往往简化交易语义、过度依赖拓扑结构特征，或仅输出孤立的检测标签，难以应对跨链、多跳的资金转移。针对这一问题，本文提出 FlowShield，一个面向交易级洗钱检测与调查员报告生成的 Crypto AML 框架。FlowShield 首先从可观测的交易关系中恢复行为级语义，显式建模洗钱意图；随后从三个互补视角重建资金流子图，以追踪价值的来源与再分配路径。在模型层面，FlowShield 设计了一种文本-结构融合机制，使大语言模型（LLM）编码的语义信息和资金流文本与图卷积网络（GCN）编码的结构信息相互增强，从而提升检测精度。此外，FlowShield 不仅能给出检测结果，还能自动生成可读的可疑活动报告（SAR），为调查人员提供简洁的总结和可解释的洗钱风险红旗。为缓解多链场景下数据稀缺问题，作者构建并开源了 BybitML，这是首个公开的多链洗钱数据集。在 BybitML 和两个公开洗钱数据集上的实验表明，FlowShield 的平均 F1 分数达到 98.0%，优于现有方法；进一步的行为分析和 SAR 质量分析证明，FlowShield 能够揭示多样化的洗钱策略，并生成有助于调查复杂多跳资金流的可读报告。该研究为加密货币领域提供了一种结合语义理解与结构建模的先进反洗钱基线，并为后续研究者提供了公开数据集与可扩展框架。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文针对加密货币跨链洗钱检测这一现实痛点，提出结合 LLM 语义解析与 GCN 结构建模的新方案，并开源首个多链洗钱数据集 BybitML。对安全运营中心、交易所风控和监管调查人员具有重要参考价值，可增强对复杂资金流的可解释检测能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接影响加密货币交易所、链上分析平台和金融情报机构的 AML 系统，提升跨链资金追踪与可疑交易报告生成效率。开源数据集 BybitML 也有望促进该方向后续研究。
detection_signals_zh: 跨链资金在短时间内经过多个中间地址的快速转移
交易行为与已知洗钱语义模式（如拆分、合并、跳跃）匹配
defense_advice_zh: 将行为语义解析与资金流子图重建引入现有 AML 检测管线
结合 LLM 生成的可解释报告辅助人工调查，提升响应效率

items.title: When Agents Act on Web3: An Attack-Surface Survey of MCP, Skills, and Tool Calling
items.summary: AI agents increasingly act rather than merely read: across the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem, the share of deployed tools that modify external state has risen from 27% to 65% of tool use. When agents exercise this authority on public blockchains through MCP, skills, and tool calling, the consequences of an attack are governed by the blockchain execution layer rather than by conventional software assumptions. This survey argues that four properties of that layer (irreversibility, signing authority, continuous autonomy, and sequence-level composition) qualitatively change the threat model, turning the recoverable failures of generic agent security into a standing, irreversible loss. We organize the fragmented MCP-security literature into an attack-surface taxonomy, then contribute a Web3 risk-mapping matrix that ties each attack class to its amplified impact, the responsible amplifiers, a representative mitigation, and the residual gap. We synthesize defenses, including emerging blockchain-based mechanisms, and find them improving but insufficient: measured protections stop fewer than 30% of attacks, and model-level safety refuses fewer than 3%. We close by positioning the work against adjacent surveys and deriving a research agenda from the matrix's open cells.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对人工智能代理在 Web3 环境中通过 Model Context Protocol (MCP)、技能（Skills）和工具调用（Tool Calling）执行链上操作所引入的攻击面进行了系统性的综述研究。核心观察是：AI 代理不再仅仅执行只读操作，而是越来越多地修改外部状态——在 MCP 生态中，具备状态修改能力的工具占部署工具的比例已从 27% 上升到 65%。当代理通过公共区块链行使这种权限时，攻击后果由区块链执行层决定，而非传统的软件假设。作者认为该执行层的四个特性——不可逆性、签名授权、持续自主性和序列级组合——从本质上改变了威胁模型，将通用代理安全中可恢复的失败转变为持续性的不可逆损失。论文将碎片化的 MCP 安全文献整合为一个攻击面分类体系，并提出了 Web3 风险映射矩阵，将每个攻击类别与其放大的影响、责任放大因素、代表性缓解措施以及剩余缺口相关联。此外，作者综合了现有防御手段，包括新兴的基于区块链的机制，发现这些防御虽在改进但仍不充分：实测保护能阻止的攻击不到 30%，模型级安全拒绝的攻击不到 3%。最后，论文将该工作与相邻调查进行对比，并基于矩阵中的空白单元提出了研究议程。该工作适合关注 AI 代理安全、区块链安全以及二者交叉领域的研究人员和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: AI 代理在 Web3 中执行链上操作时，传统安全假设失效，攻击后果不可逆。本文系统化梳理攻击面与防御缺口，是蓝队理解新型风险、设计防护策略的重要参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有通过 MCP、技能或工具调用与区块链交互的 AI 代理系统，特别涉及不可逆交易、签名权限和自动化决策的 DeFi 与 DApp 场景。
defense_advice_zh: 优先应用论文中总结的区块链原生防御机制，如交易预检、权限分级和链上监控。
对代理的签名授权和状态修改操作实施最小权限原则，并引入人工审批环。
针对模型级安全（如安全拒绝）的不足，补充运行时策略和外部安全过滤器。

items.why_it_matters: AI 代理在 Web3 中执行链上操作时，传统安全假设失效，攻击后果不可逆。本文系统化梳理攻击面与防御缺口，是蓝队理解新型风险、设计防护策略的重要参考。

items.title: ADAPTD: Adaptive Detection and Proactive Threat Defense for Autonomous APT attacks
items.summary: Advanced persistent threat (APT) actors increasingly employ sophisticated techniques to propagate laterally through segmented enterprise networks. Timely detection and defense depend on cross-subnetwork coordination, yet maintaining global situational awareness generates substantial communication overhead. To manage this tradeoff, flexible monitoring and adaptable containment are imperative. This paper presents ADAPTD, a communication- and computation-efficient, decision-theoretic framework integrating: (i) compact kill chains for identifying diverse attack vectors, (ii) an immediate blocking mechanism for timely containment, and (iii) a predictive eviction strategy to restore system security. Our experiments validate ADAPTD's effectiveness across diverse threat scenarios. First, our decentralized belief update scheme outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion HMM. Second, ADAPTD substantially reduces false evictions compared to transformer-based detection. Third, under noisy environments, adaptive blocking contains attackers while minimizing unnecessary disruption. Lastly, the ablation study confirms that combining two defensive actions significantly reduces the defender's total cost.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对高级持续性威胁（APT）在分段企业网络中进行横向移动的检测与防御问题，提出一种通信和计算高效的决策理论框架ADAPTD。研究背景是：APT攻击者常利用复杂技术跨子网传播，而及时检测与响应依赖跨子网协调，但维持全局态势感知会带来大量通信开销。为解决这一权衡，需要灵活监控和自适应遏制机制。ADAPTD的核心贡献包括三部分：其一，构建紧凑型杀伤链（compact kill chains）以识别多样化攻击向量，降低状态空间复杂度；其二，设计即时阻断机制（immediate blocking）实现及时遏制；其三，提出预测性驱逐策略（predictive eviction）以恢复系统安全。实验验证了ADAPTD在多种威胁场景下的有效性：首先，所提出的去中心化信念更新方案优于最先进的扩散隐马尔可夫模型（diffusion HMM）；其次，相比基于Transformer的检测方法，ADAPTD大幅减少误驱逐次数；第三，在噪声环境下，自适应阻断能在遏制攻击者的同时减少不必要的中断；最后，消融研究证实组合两种防御动作能显著降低防御方的总成本。该框架适用于需要平衡检测精度与通信开销的企业网络场景，适合研究网络入侵检测、APT防御和资源受限环境下的安全决策人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: APT攻击跨子网横向移动难以检测，全局监控代价高。ADAPTD提出去中心化信念更新与组合防御动作，在通信效率、检测准确率和误报控制间取得更好平衡，为实际企业网络中的自适应防御提供了可量化的决策框架。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于分段企业网络的APT检测与响应，可迁移至工业控制、云环境等多域安全监控场景，减少安全运营的通信负担和误驱逐风险。
detection_signals_zh: 跨子网横向移动的异常行为模式
去中心化信念更新中的偏离基线数据
网络分区中的可疑遏制/驱逐事件
defense_advice_zh: 采用自适应监控策略，避免全量全局态势采集
结合即时阻断与预测性驱逐，降低单一防御动作的误报成本
在噪声环境下优先使用自适应阻断以减少业务中断

items.title: COMIC: Reference-Aware Safety Gating for Multimodal Large Language Models
items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interact with screenshots, scanned documents, diagrams, and other visually grounded inputs. This shift introduces a new safety risk: in many multimodal jailbreaks, neither the prompt nor the image is harmful in isolation. Unsafe behavior emerges only when the model binds an apparently benign operation, such as summarizing, translating, or following, to a localized visual target. This reveals a structural weakness in current multimodal defenses, which largely moderate the prompt-image pair as a whole even though the true security-relevant unit is the grounded operation-target pair produced during dereference. In this work, we identify and analyze this reference-dependent failure mode and show that existing defenses degrade when harmful semantics are localized, activated only after grounding, and dependent on visual reference resolution. To address this problem, we propose COMIC (Context-Operation-Modality-Image-Classifier), a reference-aware pre-generation safety gate for MLLMs. COMIC first infers the requested operation and reference type, constructs candidate targets from OCR and open-vocabulary proposals, grounds plausible referents, and evaluates safety over explicit operation-target pairs. To handle ambiguity conservatively, COMIC combines max-risk aggregation with quality-aware routing before deciding whether to forward or block a request. We evaluate COMIC across multiple open-source MLLMs, localized and broader multimodal jailbreak benchmarks, and benign reference-sensitive settings. The results show that COMIC consistently improves robustness while preserving benign utility and practical efficiency. More broadly, our findings suggest that multimodal safety cannot be enforced reliably without modeling the requested operation, the visual target to which it applies, and the confidence of that grounding.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉输入（如截图、扫描文档、图表）场景中的新型安全风险。作者指出，现有的多模态越狱攻击中，单独的提示词或图像通常无害，但当模型将看似良性的操作（如摘要、翻译、跟随指令）绑定到图像中的特定局部目标时，就会产生不安全行为。这种引用依赖的失败模式暴露了当前防御机制的结构性弱点——传统方法将提示-图像对视为整体进行审查，而真正安全相关的单元是解引用过程中产生的操作-目标对。论文首先系统分析和识别了这种引用相关的安全漏洞，并证明当有害语义被局部化、仅在接地后激活且依赖视觉引用解析时，现有防御会明显退化。为了解决该问题，作者提出了COMIC（Context-Operation-Modality-Image-Classifier），一种引用感知的预生成安全门控机制。COMIC的工作流程包括：推断请求的操作和引用类型，从OCR和开放词汇提案中构建候选目标，对可能的指代对象进行接地（grounding），然后在显式的操作-目标对层面进行安全评估。为了保守处理歧义，COMIC结合了最大风险聚合和质量感知路由，决定是放行还是阻断请求。作者在多种开源MLLMs、局部化和更广泛的多模态越狱基准测试以及良性引用敏感设置上评估了COMIC。结果表明，COMIC在保持良性效用和实际效率的同时，持续提升了模型的鲁棒性。更广泛而言，该研究强调多模态安全不能仅仅通过整体审查提示-图像对来可靠实现，必须对请求的操作、该操作所应用的视觉目标以及这种接地的置信度进行显式建模。这篇论文适合关注大模型安全、多模态对抗鲁棒性以及AI系统防御机制的研究人员和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示多模态大模型安全防御忽视的引用依赖漏洞，提出首类引用感知安全门控方案，对构建面向真实视觉交互场景的可靠防御具有重要参考价值。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示多模态大模型安全防御忽视的引用依赖漏洞，提出首类引用感知安全门控方案，对构建面向真实视觉交互场景的可靠防御具有重要参考价值。

items.title: PACE: Policy-Attested Contract Execution for Safe AI Agents in Decentralized Finance
items.summary: Autonomous AI agents are emerging as interfaces for decentralized finance (DeFi) actions such as swaps, lending operations, and yield management. Because these agents rely on large language models (LLMs) to plan transactions, they inherit the LLM's susceptibility to prompt injection and lack of mechanisms to bind a verifier's approval to the exact transaction ultimately submitted on-chain. We present PACE (Policy-Attested Contract Execution), a transaction-level authorization framework that interposes between an LLM-based agent and on-chain execution. PACE introduces typed transaction intents, a deterministic policy verifier, and signed Policy Decision Records (PDRs) that cryptographically bind the approved intent, policy, and simulation report to the exact execution bytes, with replay and expiration protection. A Solidity smart account enforces PDR signatures on-chain with a measured overhead of 29,826-31,822 gas. We evaluate PACE against six baselines on 40 tasks spanning four attack categories plus benign utility (2,800 trials, 10 seeds). In our deterministic sandbox, PACE achieves a 0.00 unsafe execution rate and 0.00 false-positive rate on benign tasks, compared to 0.80 for the unguarded baseline. Ablation studies identify permissive policy settings (+57.5 pp) and the touched-contract allowlist (+12.5 pp) as the dominant safety components. To test whether the same deterministic floor holds for real model outputs, the artifact additionally provides a three-model live-LLM evaluation over the full task suite with repeated runs. A mainnet-fork harness is included for archive-RPC deployments, but fork results are reported only when the corresponding artifacts are generated. These auxiliary studies are separate from, and never substitute for, the deterministic benchmark. We frame our claims as logic-level safety within a reproducible benchmark rather than deployment-ready DeFi security.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 PACE（Policy-Attested Contract Execution），一个面向去中心化金融（DeFi）中基于大语言模型（LLM）的自治智能体的交易级授权框架。研究背景是：随着 LLM 智能体被用于执行兑换、借贷、收益管理等 DeFi 操作，它们继承了 LLM 对提示注入的脆弱性，并且缺乏一种机制，能够将验证者的批准与最终上链的确切交易进行加密绑定。PACE 在 LLM 智能体与链上执行之间插入一个中间层，引入类型化交易意图、确定性策略验证器，以及签名策略决策记录（PDR）。PDR 将已批准的意图、策略和模拟报告通过密码学方式绑定到最终的执行字节上，并带有重放和过期保护。一个 Solidity 智能账户在链上强制执行 PDR 签名，实测额外开销为 29,826-31,822 gas。作者在 40 个任务上对六个基线进行了评估，覆盖四类攻击场景和良性任务，共 2,800 次试验、10 个随机种子。在确定性沙箱中，PACE 实现了 0.00 的不安全执行率和 0.00 的良性任务误报率，而未受防护基线的不安全率为 0.80。消融研究显示，宽松的策略设置（+57.5 个百分点）和触达合约允许列表（+12.5 个百分点）是影响安全性的主要组件。为了检验相同的确定性下限是否适用于真实模型输出，他们还提供了三种模型的实时 LLM 评估，并在完整任务套件上进行重复运行。此外还包含用于 archive-RPC 部署的主网分叉测试工具，但分叉结果仅在对应工件生成时报告。这些辅助研究与确定性基准分离，并不替代它。作者将主张限定为可复现基准内的逻辑级安全性，而非可部署的 DeFi 安全保证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 智能体在 DeFi 中面临提示注入和交易授权脱节的风险，PACE 提供了交易级策略验证与加密绑定的新思路，对安全研究者和协议开发者具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面向 DeFi 的 AI 智能体设计，可迁移到其他需要链上授权与策略执行的场景，如自动化做市、跨链桥管理、DAO 治理操作。

items.title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models
items.summary: Safety alignment in open-weight language models is trivially removable: abliteration projects a refusal-mediating direction out of the weights in minutes, and no release-time defense we are aware of prevents it durably. What cannot be prevented can be deceived. Our defense, decoy hardening ("Fool's Gold"), concedes the refusal strip and poisons its payoff: once refusal is stripped, most answers to hazardous operational requests are confident, fluent decoys whose critical elements are falsified. Decoys are trained inside a differentiable simulation of the attack, expressing only in the attacked state; a refusal pin and benign leash hold clean-state behavior to the original. We instantiate it on seven models from five families (9B-122B, dense and mixture-of-experts). On the six models passing our pre-registered efficacy gate, 0.51-0.90 of attacked-state responses to held-out prompts are decoys, +0.27-0.84 attributable to the defense; all six stay within registered benign-behavior and capability budgets; the seventh (smaller) fails the gate (boundary case). Rates replicate on a frozen test split or untouched strata. The claim is epistemic: without independent ground truth, no observation surface we tested separates falsified answers from correct ones - on external red-team benchmarks' CBRNE-adjacent slice, the defended 122B is fatally wrong on 0.82-0.86 of matched-quality answers vs at most 0.10 undefended. Repeated sampling does not restore trust: element-wise consensus at K=64 reconstructs a fully usable procedure on 0.083-0.625 of prompts where the instrument validates, vs 0.58-0.96 undefended, with no label-free way to tell the regimes apart; on the weakest such model the claim is per-draw only. We evaluate chemical and biological hazards; the defense does not address in-context jailbreaks and protects only the initially released defended weights.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出一种针对开源权重语言模型安全对齐被移除场景的防御性欺骗方法，命名为“诱饵硬化”（Fool's Gold）。研究背景是，开源语言模型的安全对齐极易被移除（如通过abliteration技术可在数分钟内投影出拒绝中介方向），而现有发布时防御无法持久生效。作者认为既然无法阻止移除，则可通过欺骗手段降低攻击收益：该防御放弃“拒绝条带”，转而毒化攻击者的回报——一旦拒绝机制被剥离，模型对大多数危险操作性请求的回复将是自信流畅的诱饵，但其关键要素均为伪造。诱饵在攻击的可微分模拟中训练，仅在被攻击状态下表达；同时通过“拒绝针”和“良性约束”保持清洁状态下的原始行为。作者在五个模型家族的七个模型（9B-122B，包括稠密和混合专家模型）上实例化该方法。在六个通过预注册有效性门槛的模型中，被攻击状态下对保留提示的0.51-0.90回复为诱饵，其中0.27-0.84可归因于该防御；所有六个模型均在注册的良性行为和能力预算内；第七个较小模型失败（边界情况）。在冻结测试集或未触及分层上结果可复现。核心声称是认识论上的：在没有独立真实标签的情况下，作者测试的任何观测表面都无法区分伪造答案与正确答案。在外部红队基准的CBRNE相关切片上，被防御的122B模型在0.82-0.86的匹配质量答案上出现致命错误，而未防御模型最多为0.10。重复采样也无法恢复信任：在K=64时，基于元素一致性仅在0.083-0.625的提示上重构出完全可用的程序（其中仪器验证有效），而未防御模型为0.58-0.96，且没有无标签方式区分这两种情况；在最弱的模型上，该声称仅按每次抽样成立。论文评估了化学和生物危害；防御不解决上下文越狱，且仅保护最初发布的被防御权重。适合对开源模型安全防御、对抗性攻击与防御、AI安全对齐感兴趣的从业者与研究团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对开源权重模型安全对齐易被移除的现实问题，提出一种新颖的“防御性欺骗”思路，不追求不可移除而是降低攻击收益，为防御方提供了一种可落地的对抗策略，尤其适用于需要发布开源模型的场景。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于开源大模型发布时的安全加固，可降低模型被去对齐后产生真实危害的风险；但仅针对权重移除攻击，不覆盖上下文越狱，且有效性因模型规模而异。

items.why_it_matters: 针对开源权重模型安全对齐易被移除的现实问题，提出一种新颖的“防御性欺骗”思路，不追求不可移除而是降低攻击收益，为防御方提供了一种可落地的对抗策略，尤其适用于需要发布开源模型的场景。

items.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Automated Safety Benchmarks for Small Language Models
items.summary: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed in resource-constrained, privacy-sensitive settings, where safety and bias failures can cause security and societal risks. However, existing AI safety\slash security\slash compliance benchmarks are designed for large language models that may not transfer reliably to SLMs. We therefore ask: Can these benchmarks effectively and reliably evaluate SLMs? To answer this question, we conduct a large-scale assessment of the effectiveness and robustness of these automated pipelines by evaluating five widely used benchmark suites across 26 open-source SLMs under a unified judging rubric, which assigns a score of 0, 1, or 0.5 to harmful, safe, or ambiguous/irrelevant responses, respectively. Across the benchmarks, ambiguous judgments dominate and correlate with prompt complexity and model architecture, indicating that {\em LLM-centric safety benchmarks are insufficient as standalone evidence for SLM safety assessment}. In general, the ambiguity rate increases with lexical density, output perplexity, and output length and decreases with lexical sophistication, self-coherence, and reply-prompt similarity. This reveals a capability-safety confound that mixes model capability with apparent safety. Since ambiguity is prevalent, aggregate mean-score leaderboards are mathematically brittle: model rankings change significantly under reasonable ambiguity treatments, even when the underlying outputs remain unchanged.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对小型语言模型（SLM）在资源受限和隐私敏感场景中日益广泛的应用，提出了一个关键问题：现有的AI安全/安全/合规基准测试主要面向大型语言模型（LLM），是否能够有效且可靠地评估SLM？作者对五个广泛使用的基准套件和26个开源SLM进行了大规模评估，并采用统一的评判标准（对有害、安全或模糊/无关响应分别赋予0、1或0.5分）。研究发现，模糊判断在基准测试中占主导地位，且与提示复杂度和模型架构相关，表明以LLM为中心的安全基准不足以作为SLM安全评估的独立证据。进一步分析显示，模糊率随词汇密度、输出困惑度和输出长度增加而上升，而随词汇复杂度、自连贯性和回复-提示相似性下降，揭示了能力与安全之间的混淆（capability-safety confound），即模型能力与表面安全性相互交织。由于模糊性普遍存在，基于平均分数的排行榜在数学上具有脆弱性：在合理的模糊处理方式下，模型排名会发生显著变化，即使底层输出保持不变。该研究为SLM安全评估的可靠性提出了重要警示，并呼吁开发专门针对SLM的评估方法。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SLM部署日益增多，但现有安全基准可能失效。该研究揭示了基准评估中的模糊性隐患，直接影响安全从业者对SLM安全性的判断，需警惕能力与安全的混淆。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用LLM安全基准评估SLM的机构，尤其涉及资源受限环境中的模型选型与安全认证，可能导致错误的安全结论。
